CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.
   D. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons
